profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer who can bring a diverse skillset and creative drive to software application development. Energetic, customer focused, results driven, and analytical “outside the box” thinking to find software solutions to difficult problems. Strong in design and integration problem solving, organizational and time management skills. Experienced in Java, C#, Python, JavaScript (Angular JS and React JS), ASP.NET/.NET, AJAX, HTML, CSS, SQL/mySQL with database analysis and design, and all levels of software testing. Skilled in implementing software development lifecycle procedures, developing requirements specifications and user documentation using Agile/SCRUM and Waterfall Methodologies. Supportive and enthusiastic team player. Strong written and verbal communications in English and Spanish. Highly adaptable in quickly changing technical environments. Interested in a challenging technical track career in an application development environment.

projects.title: VESO Mesh: A Unified Platform for M2M Applications
projects.description: • The VESO Mesh project is sponsored by Harris Corp. The idea is to use VESO Mesh, a system developed on a previous research project, as a general platform in hardware and software for M2M applications.
